Fri Oct 23 22:22:59 UTC 2026
patches/packages/brotli-1.2.1-x86_64-1_slack15.0.txz:  Upgraded.
  This update fixes a security issue:
  A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in
  Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote
  unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose
  sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute
  arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.
  For more information, see:
    https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-111497
  (* Security fix *)

patches/packages/linux-5.15.223/kernel-source-5.15.223-noarch-1.txz:  Upgraded.
  This update fixes bugs and security issues, including the PwnEscape flaw.
  For more information, see:
    https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99999
  (* Security fix *)
  Be sure to upgrade your initrd after upgrading the kernel packages.
  If you use lilo to boot your machine, be sure lilo.conf points to the correct
  kernel and initrd and run lilo as root to update the bootloader.
  If you use elilo to boot your machine, you should run eliloconfig to copy the
  kernel and initrd to the EFI System Partition.
